Why Shielded-by-Default Matters

Financial privacy isn't about hiding — it's about choosing who sees what. When every transaction is public by default, surveillance becomes the path of least resistance...

The asymmetry problem

Transparency for the powerful, privacy for everyone else. Zcash inverts that.

The right to be let alone is the most comprehensive of rights.

Shielded pools make privacy the default, and the default is what most people get.
